attempted_claim: For C general of genus 7 and E general in B(2,L,5) with deg det E=14, the associated projective model has K_{2,1} nonzero of the stated rank r>=3 while K_{3,1}=0, giving the extremal Betti shape predicted by the rank-2 maximal-rank program; the table is certified by an explicit Macaulay2 free resolution with semicontinuity to the general member.
decisive_failure: No Macaulay2, Singular, Sage, Magma, GAP, or PARI engine is installed locally and no pip module is present; the single bounded remote SageCell probe returned no usable output. Without a graded-resolution engine the explicit K_{2,1}/K_{3,1} Betti certification, stability check, and semicontinuity transfer required by the audit plan cannot be grounded, and hand-computed Betti numbers would fail reproducibility.
